source.custom: Backgrounds: feat only, no ASI (2026-11-06 ruling).

system.description: Years of surviving alone have made you self-sufficient in ways others are not. You can perform all basic survival tasks automatically without a check in non-extreme environments. When conditions require a Survival check you make it with advantage. Your solitary travels have also sharpened your sense of direction and terrain awareness. You cannot become lost by mundane means and can retrace any path you have traveled before.
